text:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary healthcheck failing: cygnus-prod-vpc / dedicated-pool-42. Error rate spiking to ~12% on canary shard (20% traffic). Auto-rollback disabled (pinned artifact present). Paging on-call. :bell:

anna_oncall: Got it, acknowledging. I'm jumping on logs now. Any customer-reported errors? @cygnus_infra can you confirm impact?

cygnus_infra: Seeing increased 500s for our search endpoint at ~09:12 UTC, roughly 1 request in 7 failing. User impact: some api calls returning timeout/500, intermittent. Prefer a small maintenance window rather than full failover if possible.

bob_sre: Logs show KV cache miss + OOM traces on the canary instances. Suspect the canary model artifact (sha256:cafebeef01) introduced a memory regression for long-context requests. Canary was pinned by rollout config.

tyler_se: Confirmed workload shape: Cygnus has a heavy prefix-length tail (avg seq=2k tokens). New artifact appears to change KV prefetch behavior.

lina_ops: We should isolate the tenant to stop further noisy telemetry and then either pin back to previous artifact or divert that tenant to their reserved fallback pool. Options: (A) surgical pinback of canary -> previous artifact (sha256:badc0de00); (B) route Cygnus to their reserved fallback pool (dedicated-pool-42-fallback); (C) temporarily rate-limit long contexts for Cygnus.

irene_pm: Customer prefers minimal downtime, option B with a quick pinback if needed. Can we do B first (transparent divert) and keep pinback as fallback?

bob_sre: Agree. Plan: 1) Quarantine Cygnus traffic via routing rule (no global rollback) 2) Divert to reserved fallback pool 3) Confirm error rate drops 4) If not resolved, pin back artifact to badc0de00 and redeploy canary.

eng-platform: Preparing routing change now. Applying policy: `route override tenant=cygnus -> pool=dedicated-pool-42-fallback` (expected propagation ~30s). Will also mute alerts for this tenant.

deploy-bot: Routing policy applied. Audit id: AUD-20260315-7742.

anna_oncall: Monitoring metrics. Initial drop in errors to ~0.8% within 45s after divert. Latency stable. Good. Sending update to Cygnus support.

cygnus_infra: Seeing errors go down. Thanks. We still have a small number of inflight requests failing; looks like some sticky sessions hit older shards.

bob_sre: Sticky sessions are draining. I recommend we perform a pinned-artifact revert on the canary once traffic stabilizes to ensure the canary image doesn't affect other customers when we resume rollout. Pinback command (ops-only):
```
redwoodctl artifact pin --tenant cygnus --artifact sha256:badc0de00 --scope canary
redwoodctl rollout resume --target canary --confirm
```
I'll be ready to watch memory/kv metrics during the pinback.

tyler_se: Also add temporary per-tenant long-context throttle to protect the runtime: `policy set cygnus max_context_tokens=1200` — will reduce error surface while we validate artifact.

lina_ops: Applying throttle + scheduling pinback on my mark. Applying throttle... done.

deploy-bot: Policy update applied. Policy id: POL-20260315-881.

anna_oncall: Errors held ~0.5% after throttle. Ready for pinback. Lina — you have control for executing the pinback.

lina_ops: Executing pinned revert now.

deploy-bot: Artifact pin updated: cygnus canary -> sha256:badc0de00. Action id: ACT-20260315-900. Rolling canary artifact.

bob_sre: Observing canary pod restarts... memory usage back to expected baseline, KV miss rate normalized. No new OOMs.

anna_oncall: Error rate dropped to 0.1% across Cygnus. Latency normal. I'm going to lift the tenant throttle in 2 minutes and watch.

cygnus_infra: Confirming service looks healthy from our side. Appreciate the quick coord. Will schedule a postmortem with our infra team to check edge cases on long contexts.

lina_ops: Throttle lifted.

anna_oncall: No regression after throttle removal. Routing remains on fallback pool for a 15m cooldown. Recommend leaving pinned artifact until next canary candidate verified.

irene_pm: Noting customer request for a small maintenance window for deeper debugging. We'll coordinate follow-up runbook and timeline.

eng-platform: Logging run details to incident tracker: https://rwd.incidents/2425678901. Tags: cygnus, dedicated-pool, pinback, tenant-isolate.

anna_oncall: Handoff to lina_ops for post-incident ops tasks (runbook, postmortem owner). Lina — taking the on-call handoff at 09:35 UTC.

lina_ops: Taking handoff. I'll own the postmortem and next steps with Cygnus. Closing this thread when postmortem ticket is created. :white_check_mark:
